name: Vehicle Instance Segmentation
description: The Vehicle Instance Segmentation dataset pairs urban street scene images with ground-truth instance segmentation maps for vehicles. It evaluates a model's ability to segment vehicle instances in images conditioned on a natural language instruction.
card_text: This dataset is derived from Cityscapes-style urban driving scenes. Each sample pairs a left color image (input.image_file) with a text prompt (input.prompt) instructing the model to perform instance segmentation on vehicles. The target is a ground-truth instance ID map (output.map_file) where each vehicle instance is uniquely labeled. Images are complex street scenes with multiple vehicles, pedestrians, and background elements. The prompt is a short, invariant imperative sentence. The dataset assumes the model can interpret the visual scene and produce pixel-level instance masks. It is suitable for evaluating instance segmentation capabilities in autonomous driving contexts.

question.semantics: A short imperative instruction that asks the model to perform instance segmentation on vehicles in the associated image.

image.semantics: A reference to an urban street scene image (Cityscapes left 8-bit color image) containing vehicles and other traffic participants. It serves as the visual input the model must segment.

mask.semantics: A reference to the ground-truth instance segmentation mask image where each vehicle instance is assigned a unique ID, providing the pixel-level target for the vehicle instance segmentation task.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample consists of an input object with an image file path and a text prompt, and an output object with an instance segmentation map file path. The image is an urban street scene, the prompt is a fixed instruction to segment vehicles, and the output map contains ground-truth instance IDs for vehicles.
